key_insight: The paper reformulates the Wagner-model bound vortex-sheet strength so it is mathematically consistent, continuous at the trailing edge, and compatible with the unsteady Kutta condition.
engineering_relevance: This improves reduced-order unsteady aerodynamics models by removing trailing-edge artifacts that can distort circulation, pressure loading, and discrete-vortex simulations.
method: Derived a recurrence relation for the Wagner coefficients.
Built a uniformly convergent series expansion for bound vorticity.
Implemented a UTAT-based discrete-vortex method and compared it with the classical formulation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports comparison results showing the proposed formulation removes spurious trailing-edge oscillations and improves the regularity of vorticity and pressure distributions.
watch_item: The formulation adds mathematical and implementation complexity, so coefficient generation and convergence behavior should be handled carefully in practical solvers.
paper_title: Physically consistent formulation for the bound vortex sheet strength in the Wagner model
